displayAddress: Albion Street, City Centre, Wolverhampton, West Midlands, WV1
description:
Situated within close proximity to Wolverhampton City Centre, this well-presented ground-floor one bedroom apartment offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking convenient single level living.

The property briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with storage cupboard, a spacious open plan lounge and kitchen area, a generously sized double bedroom with fitted wardrobe, and a modern bathroom suite. The apartment benefits from ground floor access, double glazing, and electric heating throughout.

The open plan living accommodation provides a bright and versatile space, with the fitted kitchen offering a range of wall and base units with integrated cooking facilities and ample worktop space. The bedroom is well-proportioned and allows for additional storage furnishings, while the bathroom is finished with a contemporary three-piece suite including bath with shower attachment, wash basin, and W/C. The property also comes with one parking space. 

Conveniently located near local amenities, transport links, shops, and Wolverhampton train station, the property is ideally positioned for commuters and city living alike.

Agents notes

Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Checks

We are required by law to conduct anti-money laundering checks on all those buying a property. DB Roberts retain responsibility for ensuring checks and any ongoing monitoring are carried out correctly. The initial checks are performed using Movebutler. The cost of these checks is £20 Plus VAT (£24) for the first buyer and £10 Plus VAT (£12) for every additional buyer. This fee covers the cost of obtaining relevant data and any manual checks or monitoring which might be required. This fee will need to be paid by you in advance, ahead of us issuing a memorandum of sale and is non-refundable.
